title: spec-loop project file
description: spec/spec-loop.json: what a project adds to the base loop of spec-loop. It can only add: commands the server runs around phase moves, and instructions appended to those of the schema. It never removes a phase, a rule or an instruction.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

hooks.description: Commands run by the spec-loop server, through the shell, with the project root as working directory.

phase.description: A phase of the feature schema (x-phases).

on.description: beforeLeave: run before a forward move out of the phase; a non-zero exit blocks the move. onEnter: run right after the phase is entered; a failure is recorded and does not undo the move.

run.description: Shell command, run from the project root.

timeout.description: Seconds before the command is stopped and counted as failed; 120 by default.

title.description: Name shown in the results and the rendered evidence; the command itself by default.

instructions.description: Per phase, sentences appended to the schema's instructions in next.instruction.

onEnter.description: Appended right after the phase is entered.

beforeLeave.description: Appended once the phase is complete, before the owner is asked to move on.
